country:SWE.headline: No significant trend (down 0.0024 fraction per decade, but it could be chance)
country:SWE.detail: Not significant. If nothing were really changing, a pattern this strong would turn up by chance about 1 time in 5. A trend can be real and still too small to see through the noise: at this rate, about 8 more years of data would settle it.
